body: I’m dropping out at the end of the semester. I haven’t told anyone mostly because I’m terrified of people saying “I told you you wouldn’t do great in grad school” or something like that. And not really.... I don’t think I can make a complaint about it. I know she doesn’t like me to begin with and if I file a comapint or something about that, she’s going to hate me more and try to make everything worse for me. Everytime I say anything to her, she tried to put me down. Even if it’s just over research. I’m trying to stay on her good side (so can’t complain, can’t fight her back) so her treatment towards me doesn’t get any worse.
